title: AdminEvent
description: Keycloak admin event as produced by the KETE JSON serializer (message header eventkind = ADMIN_EVENT; x-eventkind for HTTP and SOAP)

time.description: Event timestamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch (0 when unset)

authDetails.description: Details about the admin who performed the action

resourceType.description: Resource type name (e.g. USER, CLIENT, REALM, ROLE, GROUP, …); CUSTOM when Keycloak does not recognise the raw value — see resourceTypeAsString

resourceTypeAsString.description: Raw resource type string as recorded by Keycloak (same as resourceType unless resourceType is CUSTOM)

resourcePath.description: Path to the affected resource within the realm (e.g. users/uuid)

representation.description: JSON representation of the resource state after the operation (only when include-representation is enabled)

error.description: Error code when the event represents a failure (null on success)

details.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs with extra context; only present when KETE runs on Keycloak 26.0 or later

resourceId.description: Segment after the last '/' of resourcePath; only present when KETE runs on Keycloak 26.4 or later

AuthDetails.title: AuthDetails
AuthDetails.description: Identity of the admin who triggered the event

realmId.description: Realm ID of the authenticating admin

realmName.description: Realm name of the authenticating admin

clientId.description: Client ID used by the admin (e.g. security-admin-console, admin-cli)

userId.description: Keycloak user ID of the admin (UUID)

ipAddress.description: IP address of the admin client
